name: The Ruins of Stardust
summary: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon still seeks a cure for his daughter Relara. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but a fierce fever grips her. Orendil Broadleaf sends him south for cooling stardust among ancient night elven stones.

sections.title: A Father's Lingering Despair
sections.body: Pelturas Whitemoon keeps vigil beside his daughter, Relara, as a malignant illness burns through her. Elune's Tear brought her some relief from the nightmares, but the sickness remains. A fierce fever still racks her, beyond the reach of ordinary medicines. With the temple healers stretched thin, Pelturas turns to old remedies drawn from nature, hoping to save her life.

sections.title: The Glint of Stardust
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf, an elder herbalist, points Pelturas toward the Ruins of Stardust, south across the river from Astranaar. Frosted, shimmering dust settles on the plants among the fallen marble columns and archways of this ancient kaldorei sanctuary. The powder, called stardust, has a natural chill strong enough to draw out unnatural heat. Pelturas hopes to grind it into a poultice and ease Relara's fever.

sections.title: Prowlers in the Waters
sections.body: Water elementals and wildlife make gathering the frosted dust dangerous among the flooded stones. Elementals, corrupted or stirred by changes in Ashenvale's balance, surge around the sunken plazas where the bushes grow thickest. You wade into shallows that look calm, watching for ambushes from the murky depths. The sparkling bushes must yield enough clean dust to carry back to Astranaar.

faq.answer: Relara, Pelturas Whitemoon's daughter, suffers from a severe fever in Astranaar. Elune's Tear eased her nightmares, but the fever remains. Orendil Broadleaf says the frosted dust in the Ruins of Stardust can cool her in a poultice.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Stardust located?
faq.answer: The Ruins of Stardust lie south of Astranaar in central Ashenvale, around a small lake amid ancient, overgrown kaldorei stonework.

faq.q: What is stardust in this context?
faq.answer: Stardust is frosted dust that gathers on vegetation by the lake. Pelturas hopes to use its cooling effect in a poultice for his daughter's fever.

faq.q: Does the stardust cure Relara completely?
faq.answer: Pelturas hopes a stardust poultice will lower Relara's fever. Whether it restores all her strength is learned after the treatment.

faq.q: What threats are found at the Ruins of Stardust?
aliases: what attacks at ruins of stardust
faq.answer: Aggressive water elementals lurk beneath the surface of the flooded ruins and defend the waters. They threaten anyone wading through the shallows to search the shimmering bushes.

Orendil Broadleaf is a night elf herbalist who lives in northern Ashenvale near Maestra's Post. He has studied the region's plants for centuries and advises Pelturas on rare botanical remedies when temple treatments fall short.

angles.text: The ruins south of Astranaar are remnants of ancient kaldorei civilization. Their lingering magic can still be put to use in healing.
Elune's grace soothed Relara's nightmares, but the body may need earthly remedies alongside prayer to preserve mortal life.
Finding sparkling powder in the brush takes the knowledge to recognize rare plants in Ashenvale's damp places.
To gather soothing stardust, you contend with perturbed water spirits in flooded ruins. Their presence speaks to Ashenvale's fragile balance.
